biography: Danny Formal hails from the sun-drenched streets of San José, Costa Rica, where the roar of engines was as common as the scent of coffee. He started his racing journey on two wheels, tearing up local motocross tracks before his father, a former mechanic, recognized his raw talent and built him a makeshift go-kart. One sweltering afternoon, during a regional karting championship, Danny, barely a teenager, found himself neck-and-neck with seasoned veterans. A daring last-corner overtake, immortalized in local racing lore, secured him the victory and ignited his passion for four-wheeled competition. Transitioning to sports cars, he quickly caught the eye of Lamborghini scouts. Despite flashes of brilliance, consistency remains his Achilles' heel, a trait he's battling to overcome as he navigates the fiercely competitive world of professional racing.
drivingStyle: Formal's driving style is a high-risk, high-reward affair. He's known for his aggressive entries and late braking, often pushing the limits of his car and tires. He's a master of qualifying laps, frequently securing top positions, but his tire management during longer races can be erratic. While he possesses the raw speed to challenge for wins, his tendency to overdrive the car under pressure sometimes leads to costly mistakes.
